verdict.rationale: Daytona is sandbox infrastructure for AI agents, so background automations such as scheduled or triggered autonomous jobs are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no such feature: no cron or scheduling, no triggers, and no managed background runs. What it does document (programmatic sandboxes, SDKs/CLI, Computer Use GUI control, warm pools) are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not the automation capability itself, so they earn no credit.
